title: Andrew Cohen - N° 33 - LAST TEACHINGS - Dec. 24 _ Feb. 25

Have I realized trust in in life in the dharma in enlightenment in God? Have I realized absolute trust in the highest truth? If you realize trust in the highest truth, it will set you free. When I say trusting in a mystery, can you see God with your naked eye? Can God be seen with the eye? Because God is not separate from you. Right? God does not exist outside your own self. Right? So God is a mystery that we cannot see. If you can see the mystery, then it becomes a separate object to yourself because the God principle is everywhere and nowhere at the same time.
